content: CoinCollector BIBREF8 is a class of text-based games where the objective is to find and collect a coin from a specific location in a given set of connected rooms . The agent wins the game after it collects the coin, at which point (for the first and only time) a reward of +1 is received by the agent. The environment parses only five admissible commands (go north, go east, go south, go west, and take coin) made by two worlds;
